Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the payment of interest upon failure to pay death benefits that are payable under the terms of a group life insurance policy.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the payment of interest upon failure to paydeath benefits that are payable under the terms of a group lifeinsurance policy; and adding a new section to chapter 48.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An insurer shall pay interest on death benefits payable under theterms of a group life insurance policy insuring the life of any personwho was a resident of this state at the time of death. (1) The interest accrues commencing on the date of death at therate then paid by the insurer on other withdrawable policy proceedsleft with the company, but not less than eight percent. (2) Benefits payable that have not been tendered to the beneficiarywithin ninety days of the receipt of proof of death accrue interest,commencing on the ninetyfirst day, at the rate under subsection (1) ofthis section plus three percent.
